description:
From: GC. Approved by the user 2026-11-24: asked "Shall I amend #880 with the five removals ... and file the two tickets?", the user answered verbatim "ignore it then; proceed." #880 merged (b206e60bc) before the amend was pushed, so the removals land as their own commit.

Built and checked locally as 750379b58 (worktree fz-9x7-47, on 6108d91b1; draft message GC scratchpad b47g/msg.new):
1. FZ_GRANULE_SHIFT build knob, parse_shift and its test deleted; GRANULE_SHIFT is const 5 (32 B), the profiled choice.
2. One young test: Reservation::is_young (unbounded, the literal bit is its guard) is the only implementation; is_young_in_range, arena::is_young and Heap::is_young deleted. Minor moves = !literal && is_young; fz_frame_for_write tests !is_literal before it.
3. FromSpace::of loses its dead heap parameter.
4. Stale text fixed: reduction-yielding.md (exact blocks go to the span list), imp.rs, block_pool.rs (two comments), guides/memory.html (debug cross-check; 'any worker'), ref_io.rs.
Not done: gating young_ranges/block_ranges/ptr_in_ranges behind cfg(any(test, debug_assertions)) - contains_heap_addr needs them in release for its cross-crate test caller; covered by fz-9x7.55.

b47g bench (ssh bench, 5 rounds, 3 compiles/arm): the bounded variant of the young test cost gc-cells +1.04% (consistent across compiles), others within 0.2%, so the unbounded test was kept; with it, Tracer::scan is instruction-identical to the base (453 vs 453 lines). Checks: fmt, clippy -D warnings, fz-runtime lib (808), poison_dead_frames (2).

Done when: rebased onto develop, one commit, CI green.
title: The young test is one function, and the granule is a constant
